result.keyword: What's the best project management tool for a startup?
result.markdown:
For most startups, **Linear is the best project management tool overall**, especially if you're building a technology product or running a software-focused team.

However, the best choice depends on your startup's stage, team size, and whether you're managing product development, operations, sales, or the entire business.

Here are the tools I'd shortlist.

## Best project management tools for startups

![Fast growing startups are built on Linear](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/piHpddRS6n9dTggcCRU3QzspXui7xfTg4qksC0xamyVTz0l5rmZLEYCGsVB7KKUouzfiOTbe-9ydzUq7UB2MFrNbZIGlaUSNjP0C8Bhd2CXnbxL2xZ05zw3USDTcATN8Ed4Fr3ygsGaA-sAB5VFRUeF1jd3BNolTylsoZGFQvpYkliFtHTL_AgaQh3gID9Z3?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Linear**

(Best for tech startups)

- Excellent product roadmaps and sprint planning.
- Clean, fast interface.
- Great for product managers and developers.
- Keeps engineering focused without unnecessary complexity.

Best when building a software product.

[Explore Linear](https://linear.app/)

---

![ClickUp Review 2026: Honest In-Depth Analysis & Features](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/IhDLDOyxNDHrKHznRnMbzyjIK7Vr4N5HNf17bkJW7PnIqc3qMmYgJU2IqfzLiCBJatpbDtLiH4ToLtJwHlzGNnvDPQLGe5YS9YbILi94CXJmy4xFdhZmSjqz-lpCT9-ubZzBBG-nlRcQIsvn8DaSyQoEPl_3wXUG0qs9BW4SnIccpcG_XWfRoc5BRY_9ndY5?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. ClickUp**

(Best all-in-one solution)

- Tasks, projects, documents, goals and dashboards.
- Customizable workflows.
- Useful for marketing, operations, product and engineering.
- Good value for startups on a budget.

Best when you want one platform for the entire company.

[Explore ClickUp](https://clickup.com/)

---

![Project Management Hub Template by Gridvio | Notion Marketplace](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6e1oG6Y_aW5V5yDl222hE8Y8t-T__05L0OPLqrtY2b6KrmvS_M-QH4eaVLv4afPJUAGCFGr_eoifL-Irt3_HiUqUmKW08dRjhIxW2MfVWL_nPAWNaujkMp5zdq2VbJkW7b3h6jvrTVNAFmmVU9MPLCBztqWrhslDc_LeRhpbcV451et11onvlpgBLkBnIYcR?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Notion**

- Project tracking and company documentation.
- Meeting notes, knowledge base and company wiki.
- Flexible databases and templates.
- Great for small founding teams.

Best when documentation and collaboration are priorities.

[Explore Notion](https://www.notion.com/)

---

![New: Asana’s Milestones help you visualize project progress • Asana](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/045PY8MNTZCNbuEY_9zoc2ZmyVm82bEUQrACKq4DMJ2rZRzBOKtwnHDDeSB865DF__R-b4CGI6GEhHdu4YJMzkB1qcjJuCRLXmMhkxG9zfIfGx-0L1EgDFt_aMUwOdh5HR45ijTcFpeq8HRM8juB5v_Vffpp7OzTfiaEKInBCXkUCm5590f5v87DKC8sKsga?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Asana**

- Project timelines and task dependencies.
- Clear ownership and accountability.
- Strong cross-functional coordination.
- Useful for growing teams.

Best for managing multiple departments.

[Explore Asana](https://asana.com/)

---

![Portfolio management - All Projects Dashboard – Support](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/-5NH-hROEcQXpSQPmMUJv0x7GODAoqXeNRlBaAmeb5yjL6ws1fsUSsHXZKs7cGHwGwKjC6qsKZvaA0-fO7oD8-9_bc-PbX0_EJ1QpOPifoMbrdCVNNuollQzaJIhYGySdgXpxRYlPlDaiOA8sl0RXCUZIj48mjl4S_hb7oB4Rygmeul72nI4kZxZvS769XKO?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. monday.com**

- Visual project dashboards.
- Workflow automation.
- Marketing, sales and operations tracking.
- Good reporting capabilities.

Best for startups with diverse business workflows.

[Explore monday.com](https://monday.com/)

These recommendations reflect current 2026 comparisons of startup project management software. ## My recommendation by startup stage

| Startup situation | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| 1–5 people, pre-seed | Notion |
| 5–15 people, software startup | Linear |
| 5–20 people, mixed business | ClickUp |
| 15–50 people, growing team | Asana |
| 50+ people, multiple departments | monday.com |
